riftPit.name: Rift Pit
riftPit.description: One Rift Herald and three groups of eight Voidgrubs guard a finite expedition cache. Victory awards 32,000 gold, 8 crystal and 5 ore. No artifact, deployable Herald, siege item, wall-damage power or global effect is awarded.
riftPit.onGuardedMessage: A Rift Herald and twenty-four Voidgrubs defend the expedition cache. Challenge them or withdraw.
riftPit.onVisitedMessage: The Rift expedition cache has already been recovered.

rewards.message: You recover 32,000 gold, 8 crystal and 5 ore. No deployable Herald, artifact or global siege effect is granted.

nashorPit.name: Nashor Pit
nashorPit.description: One Baron Nashor and three groups of ten Voidgrubs guard a late expedition treasury. Victory awards 100,000 gold, 15 crystal and 12 gems once. No mythic artifact, artifact set, minion empowerment or global Baron buff is awarded.
nashorPit.onGuardedMessage: Baron Nashor and thirty Voidgrubs guard the deep treasury. Challenge them or leave the pit alone.
nashorPit.onVisitedMessage: The Nashor treasury has already been claimed.

rewards.message: You recover 100,000 gold, 15 crystal and 12 gems. No mythic item, artifact set or global Baron effect is granted.

chemtechDrakeRoost.name: Chemtech Drake Roost
chemtechDrakeRoost.description: Four Chemtech Drakes guard a lost industrial expedition cache. Defeat two stacks of two for one claim of 19,000 gold, 5 mercury and 5 sulfur. No poison cloud, regeneration or global soul is granted.
chemtechDrakeRoost.onGuardedMessage: Chemtech Drakes defend an expedition cache. Challenge them or leave.
chemtechDrakeRoost.onVisitedMessage: The industrial expedition cache has already been recovered.

rewards.message: You recover 19,000 gold, 5 mercury and 5 sulfur. No global blessing is granted.

hextechDrakeRoost.name: Hextech Drake Roost
hextechDrakeRoost.description: Four Hextech Drakes guard a fallen research expedition's treasury. Defeat two stacks of two for one claim of 18,000 gold and 6 crystal. No lightning, transport power or global soul is granted.
hextechDrakeRoost.onGuardedMessage: Hextech Drakes circle the research treasury. Challenge them or withdraw.
hextechDrakeRoost.onVisitedMessage: The research treasury has already been recovered.

rewards.message: You recover 18,000 gold and 6 crystal. No global blessing is granted.

elderDragonPit.name: Elder Dragon Pit
elderDragonPit.description: A finite boss expedition guarded by one Elder Dragon and six elemental drakes. Victory awards 70,000 gold, 10 crystal, 10 gems and +3 Attack for the visiting hero's next battle. This hero-only triumph is a project adaptation. No artifact, mythic item, artifact set, global Elder buff or dragon soul is awarded.
elderDragonPit.onGuardedMessage: One Elder Dragon and six elemental guardians defend a treasury. Challenge them or leave. The finite reward includes resources and a next-battle Attack bonus for this hero; no artifact or global buff is offered.
elderDragonPit.onVisitedMessage: This Elder treasury and triumph have already been claimed.

bonuses.description: Elder Pit triumph: +3 Attack for the next battle

rewards.message: You recover 70,000 gold, 10 crystal and 10 gems. This hero gains +3 Attack for the next battle. No artifact, global buff or dragon soul is granted.

oceanDrakeRoost.name: Ocean Drake Roost
oceanDrakeRoost.description: Four Ocean Drakes guard a lost coastal expedition treasury. Defeat two stacks of two for one claim of 16,000 gold, 4 gems and 4 crystal. This land-accessible roost grants no soul, healing or global regeneration.
oceanDrakeRoost.onGuardedMessage: Ocean Drakes guard the rocky expedition cache. Challenge them or leave the roost alone.
oceanDrakeRoost.onVisitedMessage: The coastal expedition treasury has already been recovered.

rewards.message: You recover 16,000 gold, 4 gems and 4 crystal from the roost's lost treasury. No healing or global blessing is granted.

cloudDrakeRoost.name: Cloud Drake Roost
cloudDrakeRoost.description: Four swift Cloud Drakes defend a fallen ridge expedition's supplies. Defeat two stacks of two for one claim of 14,000 gold, 4 wood and 4 gems. No haste aura, weather change, travel power or global soul is granted.
cloudDrakeRoost.onGuardedMessage: Cloud Drakes wheel above the ridge treasury. Challenge them or withdraw.
cloudDrakeRoost.onVisitedMessage: The ridge expedition supplies have already been recovered.

rewards.message: The abandoned supplies yield 14,000 gold, 4 wood and 4 gems. No haste or global blessing is granted.

mountainDrakeRoost.name: Mountain Drake Roost
mountainDrakeRoost.description: Four Mountain Drakes guard a fallen expedition's treasury. Defeat two stacks of two to recover 18,000 gold, 6 ore and 5 crystal. A finite local encounter, with no elemental soul or global combat buff.
mountainDrakeRoost.onGuardedMessage: Mountain Drakes circle a rocky roost above an expedition treasury. Challenge them or leave.
mountainDrakeRoost.onVisitedMessage: The fallen expedition's treasury has already been recovered.

rewards.message: The roost yields 18,000 gold, 6 ore and 5 crystal. No global drake blessing is granted.

petricitePillar.name: Petricite Pillar
petricitePillar.description: A local Demacian waystone records practical lessons from an old expedition. Study it once per hero to gain 1,000 experience. The carved petricite grants no magic immunity or hidden spell resistance.
petricitePillar.onVisitedMessage: This hero has already studied the waystone's expedition lessons.

rewards.message: The expedition inscriptions teach this hero useful fieldcraft: 1,000 experience.

targonianFoothills.name: Targon Mount Foothills
targonianFoothills.description: A local foothill practice post teaches careful footing and defensive discipline. Each hero gains one permanent Defense point here once; it is no ascent to Targon's summit or divine transformation.
targonianFoothills.onVisitedMessage: This hero has already completed this foothill practice.

rewards.message: Foothill practice strengthens this hero's defensive discipline: +1 Defense.

voidBurrow.name: Void Burrow
voidBurrow.description: Eighteen Voidgrubs shelter around a buried expedition cache. Defeat three stacks of six to recover 2,500 gold and 2 crystal. This is a finite local encounter; it grants no global siege effect or summons.
voidBurrow.onGuardedMessage: Voidgrubs emerge around a buried cache. Challenge them or leave the burrow undisturbed.
voidBurrow.onVisitedMessage: The expedition cache has already been recovered.

rewards.message: With the burrow cleared, you recover 2,500 gold and 2 crystal from the expedition cache.

targonianStarwayCairn.name: Targonian Starway Cairn
targonianStarwayCairn.description: A local pilgrim trail marker below Targon, carved from mountain stone and marked with a regional emblem. Static scenery; it grants no movement, reward or celestial power.

voidscarOutcrop.name: Voidscar Outcrop
voidscarOutcrop.description: A small dormant Void-touched outcrop, its narrow scar clogged with dark organic crust. Static scenery; it has no visit, damage, teleport, growth or spawning effect.

freljordRimefangHollow.name: Rimefang Hollow
freljordRimefangHollow.description: A northern wolf den shelters a lost supply cache. Defeat 24 Rimefang Wolves in three stacks to recover 3,000 gold and 8 wood. The cache can be claimed once.
freljordRimefangHollow.onGuardedMessage: Rimefang wolves shelter around a lost supply cache. Choose whether to challenge them.
freljordRimefangHollow.onVisitedMessage: The lost supplies have already been recovered.

rewards.message: The hollow falls quiet. Among the abandoned supplies you recover 3,000 gold and 8 wood.

shurimanRockbearDen.name: Rockbear Refuge
shurimanRockbearDen.description: Seven Rockbears shelter around a buried caravan load. Defeat their three stacks to recover 3,500 gold, 5 ore and 2 gems. The load can be claimed once.
shurimanRockbearDen.onGuardedMessage: Large rockbears rest in the shade around a buried caravan load. A frontal challenge may be costly. Will you fight?
shurimanRockbearDen.onVisitedMessage: The caravan load is gone; the refuge offers no second reward.

rewards.message: Beneath the drifting sand, the caravan's broken chests hold 3,500 gold, 5 ore and 2 gems.

noxianBasiliskRavine.name: Basilisk Ravine
noxianBasiliskRavine.description: Four riderless basilisks prowl a ruined military depot in two stacks. Defeat them to recover 4,500 gold, 8 ore and 2 crystal. Its stores can be claimed once.
noxianBasiliskRavine.onGuardedMessage: Four powerful basilisks prowl the ravine. Will you attempt to recover the depot's supplies?
noxianBasiliskRavine.onVisitedMessage: The ruined depot has already been cleared.

rewards.message: Beyond the scattered claws and broken banners, the depot yields 4,500 gold, 8 ore and 2 crystal. Its stores are now exhausted.

ionianSpiritWillow.name: Ionian Spirit Willow
ionianSpiritWillow.description: A quiet Ionian remembrance grove. Its first eligible visitor each week restores up to 20 missing mana. A hero with full mana leaves the week's guidance available to another traveler.
ionianSpiritWillow.onEmptyMessage: Your spirit is already rested. Leave the grove's weekly guidance for another traveler.
ionianSpiritWillow.onVisitedMessage: The grove's custodians have completed their guidance for this week.

rewards.message: Lanterns sway beneath the willow. In quiet remembrance, you restore up to 20 missing mana. The ancestors' stories linger as you depart.

bandlePortalGrove.name: Bandle Portal Grove
bandlePortalGrove.description: A glade beside Bandle's hidden paths. Its winding trail grants +1 Luck for the next battle. You may return for another favor after that battle. This wayside grove does not transport your army.
bandlePortalGrove.onVisitedMessage: The glade's small favor still accompanies you until your next battle.

rewards.message: You return from a winding path with an unlikely sense of good fortune: +1 Luck for your next battle.

shurimanCaravanserai.name: Shuriman Caravanserai
shurimanCaravanserai.description: A merchant rest stop on a Shuriman caravan road. The first visitor each week receives 750 gold from a local escort contract. One payment is available per site each week.
shurimanCaravanserai.onVisitedMessage: This week's caravan escort contract has already been paid.

rewards.message: The caravan completes a short protected leg of its journey. The merchants pay 750 gold; their next contract will be available next week.

bilgewaterSmugglersCove.name: Bilgewater Smuggler's Cove
bilgewaterSmugglersCove.description: A land-accessible Bilgewater waterfront depot. The first visitor each week receives 1,000 gold from a cargo deal. One payment is available per site each week; approach along the shore path.
bilgewaterSmugglersCove.onVisitedMessage: The cargo has been sold. Another shipment is expected next week.

rewards.message: A discreet cargo delivery closes at the shore depot. Your share is 1,000 gold. No further cargo is available this week.

demacianBannerCourt.name: Demacian Banner Court
demacianBannerCourt.description: The first visit by each hero grants +1 Morale for the next battle. One muster per hero at this court; returning after battle grants nothing.
demacianBannerCourt.onVisitedMessage: This hero has already completed the site's one permitted visit.

rewards.message: The first visit by each hero grants +1 Morale for the next battle. One muster per hero at this court; returning after battle grants nothing.

piltoverFieldLecture.name: Piltover Field Lecture
piltoverFieldLecture.description: The first visit by each hero grants +1 Knowledge. The normal mana limit increases; current mana is not refilled. One lesson per hero at this site.
piltoverFieldLecture.onVisitedMessage: This hero has already completed the site's one permitted visit.

rewards.message: The first visit by each hero grants +1 Knowledge. The normal mana limit increases; current mana is not refilled. One lesson per hero at this site.

freljordReturnedShipHall.name: Returned Ship Hall
freljordReturnedShipHall.description: The first visit by each hero grants 750 base experience from local training and stories. Native experience modifiers apply. One gathering per hero at this hall.
freljordReturnedShipHall.onVisitedMessage: This hero has already completed the site's one permitted visit.

rewards.message: The first visit by each hero grants 750 base experience from local training and stories. Native experience modifiers apply. One gathering per hero at this hall.

targonianAscentCamp.name: Targonian Ascent Camp
targonianAscentCamp.description: The first visit by each hero grants 500 base experience preparing for an ascent. Native experience modifiers apply. This local camp grants no flight, Ascension or summit access.
targonianAscentCamp.onVisitedMessage: This hero has already completed the site's one permitted visit.

rewards.message: The first visit by each hero grants 500 base experience preparing for an ascent. Native experience modifiers apply. This local camp grants no flight, Ascension or summit access.

ixtaliStoneStudyStation.name: Ixtali Stone Study Station
ixtaliStoneStudyStation.description: The first visit by each hero grants +1 Defense through practical field study. One lesson per hero at this station. It grants no spell immunity or terrain shaping.
ixtaliStoneStudyStation.onVisitedMessage: This hero has already completed the site's one permitted visit.

rewards.message: The first visit by each hero grants +1 Defense through practical field study. One lesson per hero at this station. It grants no spell immunity or terrain shaping.

piltoverHexPressRefinery.name: Piltover Hex-Press Refinery
piltoverHexPressRefinery.description: The first visitor each week collects 2 crystal from a local Piltover precision workshop. One global payment per site per native week. Gold and native resource names are unchanged.
piltoverHexPressRefinery.onVisitedMessage: This week's crystal shipment has already been collected.

rewards.message: The first visitor each week collects 2 crystal from a local Piltover precision workshop. One global payment per site per native week. Gold and native resource names are unchanged.
